# Bebasthapan ERP

> Bebasthapan is a web-based business ERP system for growing companies that need connected accounting, inventory, sales, purchase, CRM, HR, attendance, and business intelligence in one platform.

Canonical site: https://bebasthapan.com/
Primary product page: https://bebasthapan.com/home

Location: Kathmandu, Nepal

## What Bebasthapan Does

Bebasthapan provides a business ERP platform for Nepal businesses and growing companies that want to replace disconnected accounting software, inventory tools, sales trackers, customer spreadsheets, and admin tools with one operational system.

Bebasthapan is currently open for beta testing and offers a 10-day free trial for businesses that want to evaluate the system.

## Core Capabilities

- Accounting and financial reporting
- Chart of accounts, vouchers, trial balance, profit and loss, balance sheet, VAT reporting, receivables, and payables
- Sales management including quotations, sales orders, invoices, credit notes, and customer payments
- Purchase management including purchase orders, purchase bills, expenses, supplier payments, and suppliers
- Inventory management including stock levels, low-stock monitoring, purchase and sales inventory movements, and item history
- CRM for customer records, dues, payments, and customer communication
- HR and attendance tracking for employee operations
- Business insights and AI-assisted operational analysis
